name: Sonus
author: fredde
description: Sonar-style volume mixer for PipeWire: output and input device pickers, per-device volume and EQ, Game, Chat, Media and Aux channels, and drag-and-drop app routing.

barWidget.description: Output, input, channel faders and per-device EQ. Scroll for volume, middle-click to mute, right-click for settings.
